definitions.gloss: refill; refill type; for refilling purposes
definitions.explanation: A product sold specifically to refill an existing container, rather than buying a new container each time. Very common for household products like shampoo, detergent, and soap.

examples.japanese: ⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧だ。
examples.english: The refill type is cheaper and more economical.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦ボトル→ボトル：11270_botoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{買|か}えば→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This detergent has refills available, so you only need to buy the bottle once.

notes:
Extremely common in Japanese daily life. Refill packs are standard for shampoo, conditioner, hand soap, laundry detergent, and many other household products. The practice reflects both cost-consciousness and environmental awareness in Japanese consumer culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう}: shampoo refill
- ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう}: detergent refill
- {詰|つ}め{替|か}え{用|よう}⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: refill pack
- {詰|つ}め{替|か}え⟦ボトル→ボトル：11270_botoru⟧: refill bottle

RELATED WORDS:
- {詰|つ}め{替|か}える: to refill, to transfer into another container
- ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: suffix meaning "for the purpose of"
- ⟦{大容量|だいようりょう}→大容量：19805_daiyouryou⟧{詰|つ}め{替|か}え: large-capacity refill

CULTURAL NOTE:
Refill products are ubiquitous in Japan. Supermarkets and drugstores devote entire sections to refill packs, which are typically sold in flexible pouches at a lower price than the original bottled product.
